Sheet 24's crop opens with '9TH ST' at the top and prints, on the north faces of block 129 immediately below it, the matching odd run '1001 1003 1005 1007 1009 1011 | 1013 1015 1017 1019 1021 1023' with 900-block avenue numbers 901,903,...,927/928 - the 800/900 hundred-block change happens exactly across this corridor. One block further south sheet 24 prints '10TH ST' with the 1002-1024 run again, so the line taken is 9th, not 10th.
